App.name: Mango Works
App.description: Rental management for vehicle rental shops

Login.title: Sign in
Login.intro: Sign in to your shop's workspace.
Login.wrongPassword: That email and password don't match.
Login.useLink: Email me a sign-in link instead
Login.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
Login.sent: Check your email for a sign-in link. It works for one hour.
Login.sendFailed: We couldn't send the link. Try again in a minute.
Login.errorSignin: Sign-in didn't finish. Please try again.
Login.errorLink: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

Picker.title: Choose a shop
Picker.intro: You work in more than one shop. Which one now?
Picker.noShopTitle: You're not in a shop yet
Picker.noShopBody: You're signed in as {email}, but no shop has added you to its team. Ask the shop owner to add you, then sign in again.

Dashboard.title: What's coming up
Dashboard.lateIntro: Overdue or failed: needs action now.

Orders.title: Orders
Orders.searchPlaceholder: Order number, name, phone, passport or plate
Orders.noResults: Orders arrive in Phase 3. Your search and filter are kept in the address, so you can bookmark them.

NewOrder.title: New order
NewOrder.intro: Book a bike and take payment. These steps fill in as the phases land.

Maintenance.title: Maintenance
Maintenance.due: Due and overdue across the fleet
Maintenance.noBikes: Bikes arrive in Phase 1. Your search is kept in the address.

Team.title: Team
Team.intro: Everyone who works in {shop}, and what they can do.
Team.name: Name
Team.inviteLater: Inviting new people arrives in Phase 11. Until then, ask Mango Works to add them.
Team.errorLastOwner: A shop needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
Team.errorGeneric: That didn't work. Please try again.

Settings.title: Shop settings
Settings.intro: Every price, report and reminder uses these. Nothing assumes a country.
Settings.name: Shop name
Settings.localeHelp: A language tag such as en-GB, th-TH or ja-JP.
Settings.readOnly: Only owners and managers can change these.

errors.invalidCountry: Choose a country from the list.
errors.invalidCurrency: Choose a currency from the list.
errors.invalidTimezone: Choose a time zone from the list.
errors.invalidLocale: Use a language tag such as en-GB.

Me.title: You and this device
Me.deviceIntro: These choices are saved on this device only.
Me.tabBarHelp: Where the four tabs sit on a phone or tablet. On a wide screen they're in the sidebar.
Me.installHelp: On a phone, open the browser menu and choose “Add to Home screen”. On a computer, use the install icon in the address bar. It's optional: everything also works in the browser.

Offline.title: You're offline
Offline.body: Check your connection and try again.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: It may have moved, or you don't have access to it.
